name: Compute Cluster S82: ffill Stat Distortion (histogram/boxplot)
description: Tests: sparse monthly data histogram without ffill distortion — minimal companion to S48.
source:
src = study_assets()()
close = src.c

ret = returns(close)
monthly_ret = resample(ret, target_timeframe="1M", agg=["Sum"])

# CORRECT: sparse monthly data → histogram without ffill
histogram(
    title='Monthly Return Distribution (sparse)',
    category='Distributions',
    bins=HistogramBinsSchema(bin_count=20)
)(monthly_ret)

# Stats on sparse data — no ffill distortion
summary_table(
    title='Monthly Return Stats (no ffill)',
    category='Stats',
    columns=TableSchema(columns=[
        ColumnSpec(name='Monthly Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
    ])
)(monthly_ret)
